page.content:
Blind earthbending prodigy who invents metalbending.

How Toph Beifong connects

  • Faction: The Gaang — Toph joins the Gaang as Aang's earthbending teacher.
  • Faction: Earth Kingdom — Toph is an Earth Kingdom earthbender.

What is Toph Beifong?

Toph Beifong is the greatest earthbender of her age, who sees with seismic sense, joins the Gaang from an Earth Kingdom tournament, and invents metalbending.

Key threads lead to The Gaang and Earth Kingdom.
